title: ActivitySource
description: An ActivitySource tells where an activity came from, for example a client, an appointment or a payment. Any entity can reference an ActivitySource. One ActivitySource can be referenced by more than one activity.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the ActivitySource entity.

business_uid.description: The unique identifier of the business that owns the ActivitySource.

source_name.description: The name of the source the activity came from. A free string, not an enum: integrations, apps and businesses write their own values (e.g., "initiated_by_staff", "website", "client_portal", "automatic_messages", "campaign", "automation", "api", "call", "rwg_redirect", "AI Receptionist", "square", "unknown").

source_channel.description: The channel inside the source, for example the widget or the medium. A free string, not an enum: integrations and businesses write their own values (e.g., "scheduler_widget", "contact_form", "client_portal_widget", "email", "sms", "csv_import", "manual_contact", "square", "Paid Search"). Most sources have no channel.

source_campaign.description: The campaign of the source, in the UTM sense: the label of what sent the link to the client. Its meaning depends on `source_name`: a message template, a campaign uid, or the business phone number (e.g., "message_request", "client_reminder", "scheduled_payments", "+15551234567"). Null for most sources.

source_url.description: The page where the activity started: the business website page with a widget, the client portal page, the online scheduling page, or the link of a message. An integration can write its own domain (for example `thryv.com`) or a label that is not a URL. Longer values are cut to 255 characters.

utm_params.description: The marketing parameters of the visit that created the source: the five UTM parameters and the Google Ads click identifier (`gclid`). Stored only for businesses with the sales account feature. Null when the source has none.

updated_at.description: When the ActivitySource was last updated.
